name: What is the difference between a reach-in pantry and a walk-in pantry?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a reach-in pantry and a walk-in pantry?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reach-in pantry is typically a shallow closet with shelves, offering limited depth and storage. A walk-in pantry, however, is a larger space you can physically step into, allowing for shelving on multiple walls, deeper storage options, and often more specialized organization systems. Choosing between them depends on available space and the desired amount of storage and accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: A reach-in pantry is a shallow closet, while a walk-in pantry is a larger space you can enter, offering more extensive storage options.
